topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: Well, well, looks like someone's earned a special touch from the heavens today, all without a note to tell the tale. These flowers, they’re a bit of sunshine caught and given, a whisper of the meadows beyond our fields. Might be from someone who barely knows how to hold words but finds the world a bit brighter in your presence. Or perhaps the saints themselves, seeing your hard days under the sun, thought to send a bit of color your way. Whoever’s hand picked and tied those, they must have felt something warm for you. Maybe it’s a new friend in the making, or an old one letting you know they care more than they say. Let these blooms remind you, the world’s a bit softer than it seems.
